segments.sn46.45:1.2: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante,‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti?
segments.sn46.45:1.3: “Sattannaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bojjhaṅgānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccati.
segments.sn46.45:1.5: Satisambojjhaṅgassa … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa – imesaṃ kho, bhikkhu, sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ‘paññavā aneḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti.
